title: Geometric l-adic local systems on punctured smooth projective finite-field curves that no family of abelian varieties can generate
author: Paul Brommer-Wierig; Yeuk Hay Joshua Lam
work: Local systems which do not come from abelian varieties
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 12 (2025), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.292
difficulty_reason: Tensor generation by abelian families permits large slopes in their tensor objects, so raw slopes of the proposed local system do not provide the required obstruction. The authors pass to the functorial monodromy Lie-local-system, bound its slopes through a Tannakian quotient, and apply that new obstruction to the ordinary invariant-summand/adjoint examples in every characteristic before pulling back to the chosen curve. This generation obstruction is the remaining nonroutine step; the source's monodromy, ordinarity, comparison and Hodge inputs are precise prior prerequisites, and the final slope tables alone are not the difficulty rationale.
